steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Level sensor hose and terminals
steps.body: Check air hose not punctured, folded, or clogged. Verify sensor terminal connections and correct part code.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check air hose not punctured, folded, or clogged. Verify sensor terminal connections and correct part code.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Repair hose routing or replace incorrect sensor part.

steps.title: Frequency check
steps.body: Connect sensor and connector. Measure frequency Pink–Orange — approx 25.3 kHz without water load.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Connect sensor and connector. Measure frequency Pink–Orange — approx 25.3 kHz without water load.

steps.title: Level sensor OK
steps.oemOutcome: Frequency and connections verified — replace PBA if 1C persists.
